name: vibecoding
description: Three separate systems in one repository: apps/landing (the website, at /), apps/saas (the product: panel at /app, script at /embed) and apps/content (/content/). Each has its own code, dependencies and lockfile; nothing is shared.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/content && npm ci --prefix apps/saas && npm ci --prefix apps/landing
scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build --prefix apps/content && npm run build --prefix apps/saas && npm run build --prefix apps/landing && node -e "for (const f of ['index.html','robots.txt','sitemap.xml']) require('fs').copyFileSync('dist/landing/'+f,'dist/'+f)"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/content && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/saas && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/landing
